title: luck vs fate
medium: Functional generative clock, each poster represents an hour. Fast changing posters represent future hours, slow changing represent hours past. 300 tarot, zodiac, i ching imagery, 300 playing cards transform into each other in an endless progression. The black and white rectangle marks the hour and the minute within. Animation, photography, software. A digital display showing the hour and minute displays every 3 minutes or when triggered by motion. Software edition of 5 with 2 APs, 12 hour videos edition of 30, and unique prints.
